notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.08)
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
- Added Level select button to level completion menu
- Level select scene now takes you to the region of your last played level.
- "Back to Menu" button in game scene will take you to the level select scene if that is where you came from.
- Basic keyboard hotkeys:
[list]
[*] Escape: Opens settings menu
[*] R: restarts level
[*] Backspace: undo move
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixes a couple of minor spelling mistakes.
- Fixed issue with "Continue" button when reaching level 100 without completing every level.
- Fixed gates not displaying properly when undoing.

notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.06)
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Screen resolution problem when changing fullscreen mode with multiple screens has been fixed

[b]Feature Changes:[/b]
- Added "Tobee Advice" setting to optionally disable Tobee coming to give advice during levels. 
- Once you reach level 15, you can skip a level to continue playing.
- When in windowed mode, you can resize the window.

notes.title: Patch Notes (v1.05)
notes.content:
A small patch to fix a couple of small bugs.

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]
- Fixed visual issue when undoing a move involving a "+" or "-" tile
- Continue button should now continue from your last played level instead of just starting you at level 1.
